hero.name: José Manuel Sánchez
hero.intro: I build real-time systems and websites that actually work for a business. From Medellín, for clients across Latin America.
about.title: About me
about.p1: I'm studying systems engineering and I build software that has to survive production, not just look good in a demo.
about.p2: I work with Node.js, Python, React and WebSockets. I'm at my best on problems where state has to stay in sync across several clients at once: live scoring, control panels, internal tools that replace a shared spreadsheet.
about.p3: I founded Lumina Dev to bring that same standard to businesses in Latin America who are tired of templates and of agencies that disappear after launch.
about.factAvailValue: Internships, full-stack roles and freelance projects
work.title: Selected work
work.spartan.title: Spartan
work.spartan.desc: Live scoring system for Taekwondo competitions. Several judges score from their own device and the central scoreboard stays in sync with no lag. Node.js and WebSockets at the core, Electron for the control desk and Capacitor for judges on mobile.
work.leadhunter.title: LeadHunter v2
work.leadhunter.desc: Desktop app for B2B prospecting. It finds businesses by area through the Google Places API, enriches each lead by scraping with Playwright and scores its potential with AI. Interface built in CustomTkinter.
work.cotizador.title: Web Quoting Tool
work.cotizador.desc: Quoting tool with live exchange rates. The client builds their own quote and sees the price update instantly, without waiting on a phone call or relying on an outdated spreadsheet.
